Guidance: Describe the unmet clinical, operational, workforce, quality, accreditation, or public-health need using measurable baseline evidence.
Define included and excluded populations, services, locations, and time periods.
Describe the complete intervention bundle: data, model, interfaces, thresholds, users, review, workflow, downstream action, monitoring, support, and exit.
Record current practice, process redesign, staffing, equipment, conventional digital tools, alternative AI, shared service, and no-change options where relevant.
Identify the authority making the decision and the hospital, health-system, payer, patient, societal, or combined perspective.
Define clinical, operational, quality, accreditation, workforce, economic, equity, trust, environmental, and safety outcomes.
State the analytic horizon and the time within which an output must lead to action.
Explain how the intervention is expected to change a decision, action, outcome, resource consequence, and public value.
Define proceed, redesign, silent validation, pilot, conditional adoption, scale, restrict, pause, replace, or retire criteria.
Record the last evidence date, responsible reviewer, planned review date, and trigger events.
